Kai Morgan: Hi all 2 I'm Kai, joining product engineering today. Super excited! Quick questions: laptop setup finished but badge not ready yet. Who do I ping for the office pickup? Also any repo access I should ask for immediately? :wave:

Nina (People Ops): welcome Kai!! Badge is queued 2 security will have it by 3pm if you bring ID. I've DM'd pickup instructions. We left a welcome kit on your desk (stickers + hoodie). Lunch outing tomorrow at noon if you want to join.

DevEx Bot: New hire account provisioned for Kai Morgan. Team access granted: product, api-gateway. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/kai_morgan. If you need extra repo perms, open a ticket in #access with repo name.

Liam Park: hey Kai 2 I'm your onboarding buddy. For local dev, run:
```bash
./scripts/bootstrap.sh --minimal
make dev
```
If you see a missing env var error, run `cp env/.example .env` first. Pairing later today at 4pm PT?

Sofia (Manager): welcome to the team Kai! 1:1 tomorrow 11am PT. Fun fact thread: post one odd skill you have so folks can say hi. I'll start: I can juggle 5 balls.

Kai Morgan: thanks everyone! 4pm PT pairing works. Fun fact: I used to ride a unicycle in college and once delivered pizza on it :laughing:. Also, re: repo access, could you add me to `product/ux-mockups` and `infra/deploy`?

onboard-bot: Access request recorded for repos: product/ux-mockups, infra/deploy. ETA for infra team review: 1 business day.

Liam Park: got it, I'll ping infra if it doesn't land by EOD. See you at 4pm, slack invite in #calendar. :slightly_smiling_face:
